# Linode | Akamai Connected Cloud

> Distributed cloud computing platform for building, deploying, and scaling applications with compute, Kubernetes, storage, networking, and developer tools.

Linode, now part of Akamai, provides cloud infrastructure and platform services through Akamai Connected Cloud. Its resources span product documentation, API references, developer guides, support content, pricing and product pages, and technical blog articles for deploying workloads globally with low latency.

## Core Platform
- [Products Overview](https://www.linode.com/products/): Overview of compute, Kubernetes, storage, networking, databases, and platform services.
- [Global Infrastructure](https://www.linode.com/global-infrastructure/): Infrastructure footprint, regions, and platform capabilities for global application deployment.
- [Essential Compute](https://www.linode.com/products/essential-compute/): Virtual machine instances for general-purpose cloud workloads and application hosting.
- [GPU](https://www.linode.com/products/gpu/): GPU instances for AI, machine learning, rendering, and accelerated workloads.
- [Accelerated Compute](https://www.linode.com/products/accelerated-compute/): High-performance compute offerings for demanding applications and specialized workloads.
- [Kubernetes Engine](https://www.linode.com/products/kubernetes/): Managed Kubernetes service for container orchestration and cluster operations.
- [App Platform](https://www.linode.com/products/app-platform/): Platform-as-a-service for deploying web apps, APIs, and static sites.

## Documentation
- [Cloud Computing Docs Welcome](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/welcome): Entry point for Akamai cloud computing documentation and product guides.
- [Get Started](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/get-started): Onboarding documentation for creating and managing cloud resources.
- [Linode API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/reference/api): Reference documentation for the Linode API and resource operations.
- [CLI](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/cli): Documentation for managing cloud resources with the command-line interface.
- [Cloud Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/cloud-manager): Guides for using the web control panel to administer services.
- [Identity and Access Management](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/identity-and-access-management): Documentation for users, roles, permissions, and account access controls.
- [Billing and Account](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/billing-and-account): Account, billing, payment, and subscription management documentation.

## Compute, Storage, and Networking Docs
- [Linodes](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/linodes): Documentation for virtual machines, provisioning, resizing, and lifecycle management.
- [Block Storage](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/block-storage): Guides for attaching and managing persistent block storage volumes.
- [Object Storage](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/object-storage): Documentation for S3-compatible object storage buckets and access management.
- [NodeBalancers](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/nodebalancers): Load balancer documentation for distributing traffic across backend services.
- [VPC](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/vpc): Virtual private cloud networking for isolated application environments.
- [VLANs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/vlans): Layer 2 private networking documentation for instance communication.
- [DNS Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/dns-manager): DNS zone, record, and domain management documentation.

## Kubernetes and Containers
- [Kubernetes Engine Docs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/kubernetes): Managed Kubernetes concepts, cluster creation, and operations guidance.
- [Deploy on Kubernetes Engine](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/deploy-on-lke): Guides for deploying workloads to Linode Kubernetes Engine clusters.
- [App Platform Docs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/app-platform): Documentation for building and deploying applications on App Platform.
- [Container Registry](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/container-registry): Manage private container images for Kubernetes and application deployments.
- [Marketplace Apps](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/marketplace-apps): Preconfigured application stacks for faster deployment on cloud instances.

## API, CLI, and Developer Tools
- [API Reference](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/reference/api): Endpoint-by-endpoint API reference for automating cloud resource management.
- [API Getting Started](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/getting-started-with-the-api): Introductory guide to authenticating and using the Linode API.
- [API Tokens](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/manage-personal-access-tokens): Create and manage personal access tokens for API authentication.
- [Linode CLI Guide](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/linode-cli): Install, configure, and use the Linode CLI.
- [Terraform Provider](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/terraform): Infrastructure as code workflows using the Linode Terraform provider.
- [Python SDK](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs/python-library): Python library documentation for interacting with Linode services.

## Guides and Tutorials
- [Guides and Tutorials](https://www.linode.com/docs/guides/): Library of practical tutorials for Linux, cloud infrastructure, and application deployment.
- [Deploying a Website](https://www.linode.com/docs/guides/deploying-a-website-on-a-linode/): Step-by-step guide to hosting a website on a Linode instance.
- [Use SSH Public Key Authentication](https://www.linode.com/docs/guides/use-public-key-authentication-with-ssh/): Secure server access using SSH key-based authentication.
- [Configure a Firewall with UFW](https://www.linode.com/docs/guides/configure-firewall-with-ufw/): Basic host firewall setup for Linux servers using UFW.
- [How to Install Docker](https://www.linode.com/docs/guides/install-docker-on-ubuntu-and-debian/): Install and configure Docker on Ubuntu and Debian systems.
- [How to Configure NGINX](https://www.linode.com/docs/guides/how-to-configure-nginx/): NGINX configuration concepts and common web server setup patterns.
- [Set Up WireGuard VPN on Ubuntu](https://www.linode.com/docs/guides/set-up-wireguard-vpn-on-ubuntu/): Configure a WireGuard VPN server and peers on Ubuntu.
